business_summary: WCON Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of connectors and cables for industrial control, automotive electronics, new energy photovoltaic and energy storage, data center, and consumer electronics sectors in China. The company offers electronic connectors, intelligent electronic products, metal stamping and metal die-casting molds, plastic molds, plastic products, and automation equipment. It also provides IDC and FPC, discrete wire, I/O, automotive cables, and solar photovoltaics cables. In addition, the company offers industrial solutions, including scientific simulation analysis, professional design capabilities, and advanced test equipment for industrial control, industrial robots, smart city, industrial internet of things, and embedded vision applications; automotive solutions, comprising mould processing capability, and assembly and mould production capacity for MCU, PDU, OBC, DC/DC, battery management system, advanced driving assistance system, intelligent cockpit, and vehicle lights; and new energy solutions, such as PSP, WD, and IDC series for photovoltaics, charging and power, and energy storage applications. Further, it provides box header, ejector header, machine pin and female header, mini jump, female header, and terminal blocks. The company was formerly known as WCON Electronics (Guangdong) Co., Ltd and changed its name to WCON Electronics Co., Ltd. in February 2026. WCON Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
